Markets.title: SME IPO: Liqvd Digital India issue to open on Sep 23; price band fixed at Rs 51-54
Markets.summary: Liqvd Digital India's Rs 39-crore SME initial public offering will run from September 23 to September 25 with a price band of Rs 51 to Rs 54 per share. The company plans to use the proceeds from the BSE SME platform listing to acquire a video content production hub.

Markets.title: Gold likely to stay range-bound next week as dollar, West Asia tensions guide market: Analysts
Markets.summary: Gold prices are expected to remain range-bound next week, influenced by the US dollar and ongoing West Asia tensions. Investors will closely monitor upcoming mid-month manufacturing and services PMI readings from major economies for market direction.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Acme Solar, Medanta among 5 stock recommendations for Monday
Markets.summary: Indian equities extended their recovery as softer crude prices and global yields boosted risk appetite. Analysts have recommended five stocks with bullish technical setups: ACME Solar, Medanta, Tilaknagar Industries, Uno Minda, and PWL.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk | India may see 50 bps of rate hikes in 2026 as Fed tightens: Garima Kapoor
Markets.summary: Elara Securities analyst Garima Kapoor expects the Reserve Bank of India to raise interest rates by 25 to 50 basis points in 2026. This potential tightening is driven by recent Federal Reserve rate hikes that are narrowing India-US bond yield differentials and pressuring foreign portfolio investments.

Markets.title: Rs 23,000 crore outflows! Is the September FII rout indicating a worse end to 2026?
Markets.summary: Foreign investors withdrew over Rs 23,000 crore from Indian equities by September 19 due to rising crude prices, US bond yields, and geopolitical risks. Domestic institutional investors are currently cushioning the market against these heavy foreign outflows.

Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine launched its largest drone attack on Moscow yet, with the city's mayor reporting that 450 drones were intercepted overnight. The massive barrage resulted in the deaths of two people.

Data & Insights.title: Why does India need to save more?
Data & Insights.summary: India needs a higher gross domestic savings rate to sustain 7-8% economic growth. This increased savings is necessary to fund ongoing investments in infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, technology, housing, and human capital.

Data & Insights.title: Saudi Arabia exits mBridge: Can China-led platform still challenge US dollar, become global cross-border payment system?
Data & Insights.summary: Saudi Arabia quietly withdrew from the China-led mBridge digital currency project in 2025 as originally planned. Despite this exit, the platform continues to expand in its efforts to enable faster cross-border payments and reduce reliance on the US dollar and SWIFT.

Data & Insights.summary: Pulses production reached a record 27.4 million tonnes and cereals output rose about 5% to 349.1 million tonnes in 2025-26. This increased crop production helped stabilize food prices while sugar rates decreased.

Data & Insights.summary: The FSSAI chief stated that the food industry must align with consumer demands regarding safety. Consequently, the food regulator is increasing its oversight of e-commerce platforms, product labelling, and school food safety.

Data & Insights.title: Festive jobs boom: 2.5 lakh seasonal and gig roles expected across e-commerce, retail, logistics
Data & Insights.summary: India expects to create up to 2.5 lakh seasonal and gig jobs between July and December, driven by a 15-20% increase in festive hiring. This hiring wave focuses on e-commerce, retail, and logistics, with significant expansion into tier II and III cities.
